blocks.text: Requirements: forward-pick slotting for top 80 SKUs

This is the working cut for PCF-1410 on February 15, 2024. Lila Voss asked for a written bound after the current path (Velocity ignored, top seller on beam 5, floor stacks in aisle B) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host slot.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on vendor slotting overlay, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Top 80 SKUs in golden zone waist-to-shoulder. No floor stacks in the pick aisle. Reject a vendor slotting overlay ($9.4k, no aisle walk). I am not restating a hallway yes. vendor slotting overlay is out because Quote did not walk building 2. They wanted a file, not the beams we actually have. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: skus=80, beam=5, cost=9.4, climbs=22.6, weeks=6, aisles=14, floor=3, walk=1.8. Sibling tickets PCF-REQ-2024-018 and PCF-SYS-2024-024. I will not reopen vendor slotting overlay in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: aisle-b2.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (06): refuse on vendor slotting overlay, lock is 80 SKUs golden zone, no floor stacks in path. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-REQ-2024-018.
If the top seller is on the top beam, we climb. Climbing is not picking.

What a skeptical lead would try first on slot.pinecrest.internal: the path Lila Voss actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.

What I will not claim in PCF-REQ-2024-018

I will not claim vendor slotting overlay is impossible at another shop. I will claim we will not do it here. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host slot.pinecrest.internal.

First useful is 80 SKUs golden zone, no floor stacks in path, not a prettier board or a louder huddle. Lila Voss sees that slice on slot.pinecrest.internal. If the slice needs a second process, that is a new ticket and Marcus Hale is in the thread. I will not hide it inside PCF-REQ-2024-018.
